summary: Defines two parameters for the CAA DNS record: one that restricts issuance to specific accounts at a CA, identified by URIs, and another that requires particular ACME domain validation methods. These give domain owners finer control than the CA-level policy that CAA offers by default.

eli5.summary: A house owner can say which locksmith may make keys, and this lets them also name the exact person and the exact way to prove who they are.
